ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (35) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Телесное» (telesnoye, 'bodily') is kept as 'bodily' in the heading and the closing thought, and «действительно» (deystvitel'no, 'really, actually') with its negative as 'real'/'unreal' throughout, so the day's single argument stays visible. In Lamennais «кафедры» (kafedry, 'pulpits, lecterns') is 'pulpits'; in the Epictetus passage the two verbs «откажись» (otkazhis', 'give up') and «отрекись» (otrekis', 'renounce') are kept distinct.
